pattern.description: After the agent's reply finishes, the chat thread scrolls up and away and the canvas resolves into a section title, 'Analyse your transcripts', with a blue gradient on 'Analyse', framed by staggered columns of call-summary cards top-left and bottom-right, under a slow push-in.
pattern.why_premium: The section change happens without a cut: the conversation literally scrolls into its own analysed transcripts, so cause and effect read in one move. The gradient accent word and asymmetric card columns give an editorial title card, and the slow push keeps it alive while the voiceover catches up.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(chatThread, {y: -720, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.in'}).fromTo(headline, {y: 40, opacity: 0}, {y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.out'}, '-=0.2').fromTo([upperCards, lowerCards], {y: 60, opacity: 0}, {y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.08}, '<0.1').to(analyseWord, {backgroundPosition: '100% 0', duration: 0.8, ease: 'sine.inOut'}, '<'); wrap the scene in a stage and gsap.fromTo(stage, {scale: 1}, {scale: 1.05, duration: 3, ease: 'none'}) for the push-in.
build_hint.remotion: chat translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [0, -720], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); headline and card groups use spring({frame: frame - delay, fps, config: {damping: 200}}) driving translateY 40->0 and opacity 0->1 with 2-3 frame stagger; gradient position interpolated over ~24 frames; stage scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 90], [1, 1.05]).

notes: Burst spans two phases: the last reply words ('right now.') appearing in the agent bubble, then the chat scrolling away into the title layout; the chat bubbles are gone in the end frame so they are not listed. camera.move is push_in (scale 1.35 over the burst) and is reported by code, not here. Entry direction of the transcript card columns is unclear from the filmstrip (they may slide in sideways). b05, b07, b18 overlap the headline or vacated chat positions and were not used.
